gen-gf-suravaram-fs-bespoke-sans: Suravaram crowds its letters together with dignified, old-school poise, its stems just a touch heavier than the hairlines. And Bespoke Sans does the opposite job, sharp and refined, leaving generous space where each curve meets its stem.
gen-gf-suse-fs-literata: SUSE draws every letter with a single monoweight stroke, so the headings look modern and smooth. But Literata brings a gentle thick-and-thin rhythm and wide, open curves, giving the text a bookish warmth.
gen-gf-suse-mono-fs-literata: Literata reads like a well-made book, bookish and a little sophisticated. Its sturdy strokes thin out only slightly, so paragraphs would keep a steady, textured grain while SUSE Mono sits above, spaced like rivets.
gen-gf-syncopate-fs-literata: Syncopate spreads its glyphs wide apart, every curve as heavy as a straight stem and no hairline anywhere. Literata then brings the one thing it lacks: a small, steady shift between thin and thick strokes.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-bitter: Syne Tactile writes with a broad-nibbed pen that never curls shut. Bitter, a grounded slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and a visible gap through each s, gives it dependable footing underneath.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-instrument-sans: Expressive and distinctive, Syne Tactile leads with its open pen stroke. Shrink it down and that gesture would fade, while Instrument Sans stays clean and unvarying, its c ends pointing apart like pincers.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-inter: Pen-nib swagger on top, smooth tubing below. Inter keeps every line flat and unmodulated, with big counters in a tall lowercase, which lets Syne Tactile be the one with all the character.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-mulish: Mulish reads modern and approachable, with no thick-and-thin modulation at all. Syne Tactile adds a broad-nibbed pen stroke and a gentle bump from small letters to capitals, so the page has one lively voice and one friendly, even-handed one.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-poppins: Distinctive and a bit theatrical, Syne Tactile earns its keep when it is big and brief. Poppins follows with loose, rope-like curves and a tall, sturdy lowercase, drawn without any thick-thin flicker.
gen-gf-syne-tactile-roboto-slab: Syne Tactile writes with a broad-nibbed pen, its stroke never closing and its capitals lifting gently above the small letters. Roboto Slab then reads precise and structured, its middle zone dominating each line, with open throats in a, c, e, and s.
